data.title: Rejection of Bauantrag for carport with storage room
data.case_title: Rejection of building application (Bauantrag) for a carport, Fl.-Nr. 88/14
data.summary: The Landratsamt Musterinn (Bauamt) rejected Kathrin Musterreiter's building application (Bauantrag) for a carport with a storage room on plot Fl.-Nr. 88/14, Gemarkung Musterinn, because the site lies in the designated flood retention zone of the Inn river and no exemption under § 78 WHG applies. A separate fee notice (Kostenbescheid) of €120 for processing the rejected application will follow.
data.explanation: This letter from the local building authority (Bauamt) refuses permission to build your carport with storage room because the plot lies in a legally protected flood area (Überschwemmungsgebiet) of the Inn, and the exceptions required under § 78 WHG are not met. No objection (Widerspruch) procedure is available here; instead, you may decide whether to challenge the decision by filing a court action (Klage) with the administrative court named in the letter, submitted in writing or recorded at the court registry — the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. You will separately receive a €120 fee notice for the processing of this application. Consider consulting a lawyer specialised in building law (Baurecht) if you want to contest the decision.
